summary: Verified the ASER Reporting reskin fix on the MOD Service Portal (/pulse). ASER now renders INSIDE the portal shell (not a full-screen dark overlay), matches the platform light theme, and integrates correctly with the Reports sub-tab bar. All 6 acceptance criteria pass.

issues: Amber/yellow info banner at top of ASER Register appears to have low-contrast text (orange-ish text on light yellow background). Not part of this fix's scope but worth a follow-up pass. All other ASER surfaces (KPI cards, filters, exports, wizard) are readable.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: ASER portal container is now `position: static` (not fixed) and renders under the portal chrome (top nav h=81 remains visible; subtab-bar h=42 remains visible above the portal). No z-index escalation, no createPortal to body.

Sub-tab active-state logic works correctly: ASER pill has class 'subtab-pill is-active' when open; clicking a sibling pill (e.g. Performance KPIs) deactivates ASER pill and unmounts the mod-aser-portal cleanly.
Close button unmounts mod-aser-portal (count=0 after click) and returns user to Reports listing.

10 KPI cards render (Entries This Month, Open Entries, High-Risk, Removed From Use, Repeated-Issue Kit, Rehab Sessions Impacted, Group Programmes, Individual Programmes, CAPEX Evidence Flags, Total Entries) with dark-on-light readable text (color rgb(24,24,27)).
New ASER Entry wizard opens INLINE inside the shell (29 inputs detected) — themed and usable.
Analytics empty-state is themed correctly ('No data to chart yet' inside a dashed themed card) — no charts to test because register has 0 entries, which the review notes is acceptable.
